  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  November 04, 2019

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the October 28, 2019, meeting.

  2. Visible Graphics – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for fabrication
  and installation of vinyl frosting to doors and windows.

  3. Integra Realty Resources – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the
  consulting and appraisal services of a vacant lot.

  4. Securitas – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing service’s
  for armed security guards for detainees.

  5. Grafix Systems - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  decals for police service vehicles.

  6. Country Hills Animal Clinic – Executive session to discuss recommended payments for
  veterinarians to provide services to our Canines.

Closed Session - Confidential
  7. Closed session-Confidential-Attorney/Client Privileged; Executive closed session Claims
  Review Committee with Legal Counsel regarding pending litigation pursuant to California
  Government Code §54956.9(a)); Ramon Harrold Claim for damages.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.
 Adjournment.

City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  November 04, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:34 a.m.:

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer Department
  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Ken Campos, Legal Department

  Staff Present:  Micah Herd, Police Department
  Damian Pipkins, Housing Department
  Marisela Mansour, Parks, Recreation Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of October 28, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Visible Graphics – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  services of removal and installation of vinyl frosting to doors and windows in the
  amount of $4,237.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Integra Realty Resources – Item pulled.

  4. Securitas – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  service’s for armed security guards for detainees in the amount of $4,240.00. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  5. Grafix Systems - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  decals for police service vehicles in the amount of $3,151.95. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  6. Country Hills Animal Clinic - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  providing veterinarians services to our Canines in the amount of $2,510.85. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  1. Closed Session- Confidential

Minutes  Page 2 of 2

  Ramon Harrold vs City of Inglewood- Item was pulled.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 12:23 p.m. Adjournment
